# Desert Safaris

> Premier Texas and New Mexico hunting outfitter specializing in trophy mule deer, exotic game, and free-range hunts led by professional guide Hunter Ross.

Desert Safaris is a full-service hunting outfitter operating across West Texas, the Trans-Pecos region, and New Mexico. The company offers guided hunts for native and exotic game species on private ranches, with comprehensive lodging, seasonal information, and trophy hunting packages.

## Key Topics

- Mule Deer Hunting
- Exotic Game Hunting
- Trophy Hunting
- West Texas
- Free-Range Hunting
- Aoudad Sheep
- Pronghorn Antelope
- Axis Deer
- Hunter Ross
- Guided Hunts
- Texas Hunting Outfitter
- Trans-Pecos
- New Mexico Hunting
- Safari-Style Hunts
- MLDP (Managed Land Deer Permit)

## Core Services & Game Species

- [Exotic Game Hunting in Texas with Desert Safaris](https://www.desertsafaris.net/exotics.asp): Exotic game hunting trips on private Texas ranches
- [Mule Deer Hunting in Texas](https://www.desertsafaris.net/texasmuledeer.asp): Mule deer hunting services on West Texas private ranches
- [Mule Deer Hunting, Texas Mule Deer Hunting West Texas](https://www.desertsafaris.net/mgtmuledeer.asp): Management hunts for mule deer in West Texas ranches
- [Aoudad Sheep Hunting in Texas, Free Range Aoudad Sheep Hunting](https://www.desertsafaris.net/fraoudadsheep.asp): Free range aoudad and barbary sheep hunting in Texas
- [Pronghorn Antelope Hunting New Mexico - Texas](https://www.desertsafaris.net/pronghorn.asp): Guided pronghorn antelope hunting in New Mexico and Texas
- [Free Range Axis Deer Hunting in Texas](https://www.desertsafaris.net/fraxisdeer.asp): Free range axis deer hunting packages in Texas Hill Country
- [Desert Safaris Combo Trip](https://www.desertsafaris.net/combotrip.asp): Combination hunting trips with multiple game species
